title: Isomorphic Strings
statement:
Two strings A and B are isomorphic if the characters in A can be replaced to get B, such that:
- Each character in A maps to exactly one character in B.
- No two characters in A map to the same character in B.
- The mapping is consistent throughout.

Given strings A and B of equal length, print "Yes" if they are isomorphic, otherwise print "No".
inputFormat: Two lines: the first contains A, the second contains B.
outputFormat: Print "Yes" if A and B are isomorphic, otherwise "No".
constraints:
1 <= |A| = |B| <= 10^5
A and B contain only lowercase English letters.
